card.name: Words just before "drugs" in interactions
card.fires_on: The last word before the noun "drugs" (or "products") in drug-interaction text, such as "these", "other", "coadministered", or the ending of a hyphenated or chemical modifier. It looks ahead to a plural drug noun.

modes.label: Determiners before drugs
modes.description: Words like "these" or "other" right before "drugs" in co-administration statements.
modes.example: CONCOMITANT ADMINISTRATION OF<< THESE>> TWO DRUGS CAN LEAD TO

modes.label: Modifier endings before drugs/products
modes.description: The final piece of a modifier such as -containing, nephrotoxic, or Ergot-type, just before drugs or products.
modes.example: NEUROTOXIC AND/OR NEPHROTOX<<IC>> DRUGS WITH POLYMYX

card.writes: It pushes toward a noun like "drugs" or "command" and away from "product" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before "drugs" when a label discusses interactions with other medicines.
